prompt: A 54-year-old man on thrice-weekly hemodialysis has missed several sessions because the van service in his neighborhood is unreliable, and he presents with volume overload. How should the care team respond?

rubric_items.text: Identifies transportation insecurity as the root cause of the missed sessions rather than labeling the patient nonadherent.
Addresses the acute issue of volume overload with appropriate urgency, including arranging dialysis promptly.
Engages social work or case management to arrange reliable transportation (e.g., Medicaid non-emergency medical transportation, dialysis-unit transport programs).
Considers practical accommodations such as scheduling changes or a dialysis unit closer to home.
Documents and follows up to confirm the transportation plan is working.
